subject: Compliance acceptance corridor: SOC 2, retention & pen-test sequencing
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Alice Thompson <alice@finedge.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Call recap — SOC 2 / retention / pen test questions

Thanks again for carving out 30 minutes today — appreciate the clarity on FinEdge's priorities. Quick recap below so we're aligned and you have a single list to share with legal/infosec. Please flag anything I've misinterpreted.

Key pain points (FinEdge):
- Audit log retention: need configurable retention policies per environment (prod = 12 months, staging = 90 days) and exportable audit traces for regulator requests.
- Evidence for SOC 2: you need an index of artifacts we can provide, plus optional redacted reports for third-party assessments.
- Pen test cadence & artifacts: you prefer a vendor-conducted pentest window + summary report rather than raw exploit artifacts; FinEdge legal needs proof of remediation timelines.
- DPA language: procurement asked for a DPA with specific data retention and subprocessor clauses (will share markups).

Goals we agreed on:
1) Provide an evidence index (CSV) showing which SOC 2 artifacts we can share and how (redacted report / artifact export).
2) Map audit-log retention options + technical approach for exporting logs for requests.
3) Share a draft DPA with our standard retention clause and a quick redline path.
4) Propose a pen-test support plan (timeline, what we can provide, redacted report delivery SLA).

Immediate next steps (owners + suggested dates):
- Redwood: send SOC 2 evidence index + DPA template (Irene) — target: 2026-11-24 EOD. Attachment: redwood-soc2-evidence-index.csv, redwood-dpa-template.docx.
- FinEdge: send legal markups and security_requirements workbook (Alice) — target: 2026-11-25.
- Redwood Eng/CS: coordinate feasibility of 12-month retention and export path; provide engineering note with options (Karthik/Marcus) — target draft: 2026-11-27.
- Joint: schedule a 30-min follow-up (technical + legal) — propose 2026-11-29.

References: HubSpot deal FDG-1829 (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/FDG-1829)

Attachments (sent with this message): redwood-soc2-evidence-index.csv, redwood-dpa-template.docx

Thanks — I know some items are tight; we can prioritize the evidence index and the DPA redline so your procurement can move forward.

Best,
Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

--

[attachment stub] redwood-soc2-evidence-index.csv (CSV list: artifact id, type, redaction policy, expected delivery)
[attachment stub] redwood-dpa-template.docx (standard Redwood DPA template)

From: Alice Thompson <alice@finedge.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Cc: FinEdge Legal <legal@finedge.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T17:01:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Compliance acceptance corridor: SOC 2, retention & pen-test sequencing

Irene — thanks for the crisp recap. This matches our call. Quick clarifications from legal/infosec side:

- Retention: prod = 12 months is non-negotiable for now. We also need a documented export procedure for regulatory eDiscovery requests (SLA: 5 business days).
- Pen test reporting: our security lead prefers a redacted executive summary + CVSS mapping for any findings. Full reports can be shared under NDA but procurement usually accepts redacted summaries.
- DPA: legal will do a first-pass markup and share by 11/25; main asks relate to subprocessors and a 90-day data purge path after contract termination.

I've attached our security requirements workbook — it adds a few specific controls (SAML SSO, KMS integration options, and proof of log immutability).

We can tentatively hold 11/29 for a 30-min follow-up; I'll confirm calendar invite once we have your evidence index.

Thanks,
Alice
Director of Compliance, FinEdge

--

> Thanks again for carving out 30 minutes today — appreciate the clarity on FinEdge's priorities...

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-23T09:18:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Compliance acceptance corridor: SOC 2, retention & pen-test sequencing

Irene / Karthik — quick internal note following Alice's reply. High level feasibility thoughts and owners:

- 12-month retention: doable. Two implementation paths: native retention + export API or streaming logs to customer-managed S3. Export SLA (5 business days) is achievable but requires an ops playbook for on-call if data needs to be reconstructed from clusters.
  Owner: Marcus (eng liaison) + CS (for runbook) — estimate effort: 3 dev-days + 1 SRE-day to document/export path.

- SOC 2 artifacts: we already have most artifacts; I can produce a redacted pen-test executive summary on request. We should confirm what FinEdge needs (index vs. copies).
  Owner: Marcus to assemble redacted artifacts; Karthik to verify attestation language.

- Pen test: our vendor cadence is quarterly by default; for FDG-1829 we can offer a targeted window and provide a redacted summary within 10 business days after report receipt. If legal needs full reports under NDA, we can facilitate.
  Note: there may be a small professional-services time & cost component if they request a dedicated remediation schedule.

I'll draft a short engineering note for Irene's email (target 11/24 AM) that outlines the two retention approaches and the export SLA.

Marcus
Principal Engineer, Product Infrastructure | Redwood Inference

--

Date: 2026-11-24T09:02:00-08:00
Subject: Finalized deliverables & next meeting — FDG-1829

Hi Alice / team — thanks for the fast turnaround. Follow-up and firm commitments based on Marcus's note: 

Deliverables (what we'll send):
- SOC 2 evidence index (CSV) — attached. This maps artifact -> redaction option -> expected SLA. (Irene) — delivery: today 11/24 EOD.
- Engineering note: retention approaches + export playbook draft (Marcus) — delivery: 2026-11-24 AM.
- DPA draft: our baseline DPA (attached) — Irene to ask for your redlines; we can route the DPA through DocuSign after legal thumbs-up.
- Pen-test support plan: we can provide a redacted executive summary within 10 business days after vendor report; full report exchange under NDA if requested (Marcus) — draft plan: 2026-11-27.

Proposed next steps and dates:
1) FinEdge legal to send markups by 11/25 — Alice to confirm.
2) Redwood sends engineering note + evidence index by 11/24 (done / in-flight).
3) 30-min sync (tech + legal) — proposed 2026-11-29 10:00-10:30 PT. I'll send a calendar invite once we confirm.

I attached the evidence index and the DPA template for initial review. If these look good we can move DPA to DocuSign so procurement has something to sign while engineering finalizes the runbook.

Thanks all — appreciate the quick partnership here.

Best,
Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
